text:
Marta (AE): Heads-up — CassioHealth wants to run a 2-week POC next week. They submitted tera-v2-14b-ft (hf tar) with a custom norm layer and a small LoRA. Requirements: demo on Hosted, production on Dedicated later; p95 <220ms for chat; int4 option; KMS + DPA; and estimate for ~75M gen tokens/mo. Can infra validate compatibility and perf?

Ravi (Sales Eng): Copy. I'll start drafting pricing scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) but need perf numbers. Also confirm whether LoRA should be merged or served separately.

Jon (Infra): Starting a quick compat sweep. Questions: model file format (hf tar ok), tokenizer files included? Any custom CUDA ops called out?

Marta (AE): Tokenizer included. No custom cuda ops noted but config mentions "rmsnorm_v2" and "kv_cache: true". Link to the upload: https://redwood.internal/deals/cassiohealth/artifacts

ops-bot: compat-scan job queued for 6176543210

ops-bot: compat-scan results:
- tokenizer: OK
- kv_cache: SUPPORTED (prefix cache validated)
- rmsnorm_v2: WARN (no fused kernel on prod runtime; falls back to generic kernel)
- int4 path: PASS (quant config X2 recommended; small attention scaling fix required)
- LoRA: detected adapter files; runtime supports on-the-fly adapter apply but merging advised for latency-sensitive POC

Jon (Infra): I can patch prod-runtime canary with rmsnorm_v2 fusion for the POC. Also will try int4 profile X2 on qsm-rt-5 and run short microbench.

Ravi (Sales Eng): For pricing: rough hosted ballpark for 75M tokens ~ $800-$2.2k/mo depending on cache hit rate. Dedicated starts to make sense at sustained volume + strict latency. I'll lock numbers after perf data.

Jon (Infra): Microbench results (qsm-rt-5, int4 X2, merged LoRA, batch=6): steady-state p95 = 165ms for 1k context; cold-start ~420ms. With prefix KV warmup p95 drops to ~150ms. Without the rmsnorm fusion it was ~240ms p95.

Asha (Security): Reminder: customer will process PHI in POC. Need KMS integration (Azure Key Vault), DPA signed before data ingress, and audit log retention of 1 year. Please add wiring docs to dealbook.

Marta (AE): Understood — legal is on standby to push DPA. Jon, can you add KMS wiring checklist to dealbook?

Jon (Infra): Added KMS checklist + step-by-step for service principal and key rotation. ops-bot provisioned a hosted trial env (trial-ct-617654). Endpoint creds uploaded to dealbook.

ops-bot: hosted trial provisioned (trial-ct-617654) — endpoints/creds uploaded

Ravi (Sales Eng): Thanks. I'll update price sheet with both cached and uncached scenarios and include a POC plan: 2-week hosted trial (200k token/day cap) then optional Dedicated demo with reserved slot for stress run.

Asha (Security): Uploaded initial answers to the security questionnaire to dealbook. Open items: proof of key separation, details on plaintext handling, and confirmation of audit log delivery path to customer. I'll work with Jon on the KMS docs.

Marta (AE): Customer wants a Friday demo. Can we have canary with rmsnorm fusion and hosted slot ready by Thursday?

Jon (Infra): Canary with rmsnorm_v2 fusion scheduled now. ops-bot will post when done.

ops-bot: canary deploy started -> runtime-rmsnorm_v2-fusion (start 6176543220)

ops-bot: canary deploy complete — fusion active on canary nodes

Jon (Infra): Re-ran microbench after canary: cold-start ~350ms, steady p95 ~160ms with prefix warmup. Looks good for demo.

Ravi (Sales Eng): Price sheet updated and uploaded. Sent note to finance for hosted unit rates.

Asha (Security): Security Q updated with KMS wiring and audit retention sections filled. No blockers from security side for the POC once DPA signed.

Marta (AE): Great — demo scheduled Friday 9am PT. I'll share creds with the customer. Please ping here once the Hosted trial shows healthy metrics.

Jon (Infra): Hosted trial is live and receiving traffic. Ops dashboard shows steady p95 ~155-170ms, cache hit ~72%.

Ravi (Sales Eng): All set from my side. I'll join the demo and cover pricing/next steps.

Marta (AE): Thanks team!
